selection: Max mean per-layer expert-count TV; tie-break by mean per-layer rank-count TV, then family IDs. No timings used.
nonzero_contrast: Any non-identical expert histograms. This is not an approved practical-effect or statistical threshold.
partitions: Screen inputs used only in A. B uses predetermined different evaluation input variants; warmup input is separate. No held-out GPU outcomes used for selection.
hypotheses: At matched request/token/context/grant shapes, routing profiles may differ.
Observed expert/dispatch/combine intervals may differ, or remain unchanged within small-sample variation. Neither outcome alone establishes causal routing latency effects.
caps: A: 1 diagnostic warmup + 6 screens. B: 3 warmups + 18 fixed episodes. No rate ramp or automatic A-to-B launch.
timing_limits: Device stream intervals, not pure network or kernel time; cross-device clocks not aligned. Control leaves routing unobserved; common scheduler/CPU ledger overhead not estimated.
primary_structural_prediction: At the same 32-token/owner/grant shapes, AGRS logical payload shapes/bytes remain constant while realized expert histograms can change.

exploratory_alternatives.H0: Held-out routing contrast exists but observed intervals do not separate beyond recorded repeat variation.
exploratory_alternatives.H1: Held-out routing contrast co-occurs with repeatable component-interval differences despite matched serving/payload shapes.
exploratory_alternatives.decision_limit: Three repeats are descriptive; no formal rejection, equivalence, causal timing or essential-state declaration.
